description: This file defines the UserInterface interface for Drupal's user module, specifying methods and constants related to user entities, roles, credentials, and account status.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role by role ID.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a role to the user.

methods.name: removeRole
methods.description: Removes a role from the user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for the user account.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the hashed password of the user.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets a new password for the user.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the user.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user account is active.

methods.name: isBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the user account is blocked.

methods.name: getInitialEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the initial email used during registration.

methods.name: setExistingPassword
methods.description: Sets the existing plain text password for validation.

methods.name: checkExistingPassword
methods.description: Verifies the existing password against the account.
